title: Bloodline Mystery
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji sat alone in the quiet chamber deducing, a chilling thought emerged—Chen Tianming's 'fall' all those years ago might have been, from beginning to end, a meticulously designed chess game.

text.content: The moment the voice entered his ear, Chen Ji's smile remained unchanged as he clasped his hands in farewell to those present. Only he knew that the aged, majestic voice was hissing in his ear like a venomous snake: 'This matter concerns the survival of the imperial clan, it's no small thing.' His fingertips trembled slightly before he nonchalantly followed the imperial representative out of the side hall. Outside, the moonlight was cold and clear, and two silhouettes stopped at the end of the corridor.

dialogue.content: May I inquire what guidance the senior has? I am merely a menial servant of the Tianqing Sect, hardly worthy of the title 'Grand Tutor.'

text.content: The imperial representative turned around, his originally dull eyes suddenly blazing with piercing sharpness. With a casual wave of his hand, he erected an isolation barrier around the two, his voice low and profound: 'A menial servant? Chen Grand Tutor, do you truly believe this old man doesn't know where your Chen family's ancestral land lies?' Chen Ji's pupils contracted, alarm bells ringing in his heart. Master Mo had never mentioned that his background could be so easily perceived by outsiders—this old man's origins were clearly far deeper than he initially appeared.

dialogue.content: Since the senior knows the Chen family's ancestral land, you must also know that place has long been reduced to ruins. What exactly does the senior desire?
Ruins? What if this old man told you that beneath those ruins is sealed a primordial secret connected to your bloodline?

text.content: The old man's words were like a blade precisely piercing Chen Ji's softest spot never shown to others. His expression unchanged, his heart was already churning with immense waves. The true secret of the Chen family's ancestral land was something even Master Mo treated with extreme caution—how much did this old man actually know? Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment on his chest suddenly grew warm, and that familiar yet strange agitation returned—the sensation that something dormant was slowly awakening.

dialogue.content: ...If the senior has something to say, please speak directly. Chen Ji will listen attentively.

text.content: The imperial representative stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, uttering an earth-shattering secret word by word: 'Within the imperial bloodline, a fragmentary soul of an ancient supreme being is sealed. And the master of this fragmentary soul shares an inseparable blood kinship with your Chen family's ancestors.' Before the words even finished, Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest, as if something was violently撞击 his heart. The ancient will dormant in his body for years had now awakened like a蛰龙, creating some bizarre resonance with the imperial bloodline.

choice.prompt: Facing this bloodline truth that could overturn cognition, Chen Ji chose...

choices.description: Since avoidance is impossible, he might as well ask everything clearly—what exactly is the ancient will? What connection does it have with the imperial clan?
choices.visible_reward: Gain Key Intelligence, Understand Own Bloodline Secrets
choices.risk_hint: The Other Party May Have Other Schemes

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressed the surging ancient will within his body, his gaze sinking as he said: 'Since it's a bloodline secret, Chen Ji shall certainly listen attentively. But since the senior knows of this matter, why seek out this useless menial servant like me?'

choices.description: Act like a frightened useless person, find an opportunity to escape—wait until he understands the other's bottom line before making calculations
choices.visible_cost: Miss the Opportunity to Question Directly
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Trump Cards, Strive for Intelligence Initiative
choices.risk_hint: If the Other Party Has Already Set a Trap, He May Not Easily Escape

text.content: Chen Ji's expression suddenly turned ashen, he stumbled back two steps, his voice trembling: 'Senior... Senior must be joking. Chen Ji is merely an ordinary mortal, how... how could I possibly bear some great being's fragmentary soul...' While his eyes flickered, he was already rapidly calculating strategies to escape.

choices.description: Advance Through Retreat, Use Words to Probe How Much the Other Party Actually Knows, Then Decide the Next Move
choices.visible_cost: May Fall Into the Other Party's Verbal Traps
choices.visible_reward: Distinguish the Truth of Intelligence, Judge the Other Party's Stance

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled—that smile appeared simple and honest but actually concealed sharp edges: 'The senior's meaning is... within this useless one's body still hides something extraordinary? I wonder if the senior might enlighten me. Chen Ji shall listen attentively.'

The imperial representative watched Chen Ji's reaction, a glint of amusement flickering in his eyes. He reached into his sleeve and produced an ancient jade slip, its surface flowing with patterns identical to the Tianji Record Fragment on Chen Ji's chest. 'This is recorded in the imperial clan's secret scrolls—the Chen family's ancestral land and the imperial clan's ancestral land are merely the two ends of the same temporal-spatial rift. A thousand years ago when that supreme being fell, he divided his entire cultivation into two halves—one sealed within the imperial bloodline, the other residing in the Chen family's ancestral soul.'

Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the shock in his heart, yet his face had already turned deathly pale. He could clearly sense the ancient will within him growing frantically agitated, as if trying to break through some kind of confinement. That was... a call from deep within the bloodline, unfamiliar yet utterly familiar, like the roots a wanderer had long been seeking. Master Mo had never mentioned any of this, and the Tianji Record Fragment had never shown him such visions—what did all of this mean?

dialogue.content: ...Who exactly was that ancient supreme being?

text.content: These five words exploded like thunder beside Chen Ji's ear. The Seventh Chess Player—that was an existence never recorded in the Tianji Record inheritance, a forbidden topic Master Mo treated with extreme caution. His pupils dilated sharply, his mind racing: if what the imperial clan said was true, then the ancient will dormant within him was none other than the remnant will of the Seventh Chess Player? And Chen Nian... he suddenly thought of that sister taken away by the Holy Sect—why could she interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight? Could she possibly be the true...

choice.prompt: Regarding the truth of the Seventh Chess Player, Chen Ji decided...

choices.description: What connection does Chen Nian have with all this? Was her being taken by the Holy Sect related to this?
choices.visible_reward: Gain Key Information About Chen Nian's Whereabouts
choices.risk_hint: The Other Party May Use This as Leverage

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze condensed, his voice slightly hoarse: 'The Seventh Chess Player... does it have any connection with my sister who disappeared years ago?'

text.content: The imperial representative gave him a deep look: 'You're quite sharp. Indeed, your sister was taken by the Holy Sect precisely because within her flows the same pure bloodline as yours—the final lifeline left by the Seventh Chess Player for the mortal realm.'

choices.description: Why Does the Imperial Clan Know These Secrets? Friend or Foe?
choices.visible_reward: Probe Out the Other Party's True Purpose

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly let out a cold laugh: 'The senior speaks endlessly of imperial clan secrets, yet knows everything about my Chen family affairs. May I ask, who exactly are you? Such eagerness—could it be you wish to use Chen Ji to accomplish some unspeakable deed?'

text.content: The old man didn't get angry; instead he smiled: 'Well said, Chen Grand Tutor—this vigilance does justice to your reputation for scheming across the world. Who this old man is doesn't matter. What matters is—do you want to save your sister?'

choices.description: Speak no more, quietly observe—let the other party reveal their cards first
choices.visible_reward: See the Full Picture of the Other Party's Layout
choices.risk_hint: Time Is Not on One's Side

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, only quietly watching the old man. Under the moonlight, his eyes were unfathomable, like an abandoned well—regardless of how the world raged, the person at the bottom remained at ease. Upon seeing this, the old man反而 showed a hint of appreciation: 'Good, your composure runs deep. Since it's so, this old man will speak directly—the imperial clan is willing to use the Chen family's ancestral land remnant map as the lure, in exchange for one promise from you, Chen Ji.'

Chen Ji did not answer immediately. In his mind, countless possibilities were racing—why was the imperial clan extending an olive branch now? Was it genuine cooperation or did they have ulterior motives? More importantly, how much did Master Mo actually know about all this? That seemingly protective remnant soul—was it also hiding something? He slowly raised his head, and by the moonlight, that ordinary face bore a meaningful smile: 'A promise... I wonder what kind of promise the imperial clan desires?'

dialogue.content: This old man only asks you to remember one thing—regardless of when the one within you awakens, never let it completely devour you. The will of the Seventh Chess Player... is far more dangerous than you can imagine.

text.content: These words made Chen Ji's heart jolt. He subconsciously sensed the ancient will within his body, only to find it had already fallen silent again, as if it had never awakened. But that sensation of bloodline connection moments ago was too real, too real for him to deceive himself that it was merely an illusion. He took a deep breath and was about to speak when he suddenly sensed an extremely covert spiritual awareness sweep over from afar—it was Su Qingyao's aura. Was she secretly monitoring? Or also investigating something?

Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, yet in his heart he had already made his decision. He clasped his hands toward the old man: 'I appreciate the senior's kindness, but this matter carries tremendous weight. Please allow Chen Ji to consider it.' The old man seemed to have anticipated this response, nodding meaningfully: 'In three days, this old man will await you at the Tianji Pavilion east of the city. By then, you may have a different answer.' As his words fell, the old man's figure dissolved like dust into the night.

The night wind blew past, Chen Ji stood alone at the end of the corridor, his robes rustling in the wind. In his hand had somehow appeared a jade slip—the one the old man had secretly placed in his palm without Chen Ji noticing. The jade slip was warm, faintly transmitting a piece of information: the entrance coordinates of the temporal-spatial rift, and a line of text—'Chen Tianming's fall was actually the starting point of the Seventh Path of Reincarnation.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Chen Tianming... his father, that man who had been 'dead' for many years—had he truly never left?
